WITH salary_formats AS (
    SELECT
        Location,
        Salary,
        CASE WHEN instr(Salary, '/') > 0
             THEN substr(Salary, instr(Salary, '/'))
             ELSE '(no suffix)'
        END AS suffix,
        CASE WHEN instr(Salary, '/') > 0
             THEN substr(Salary, 1, instr(Salary, '/') - 1)
             ELSE Salary
        END AS amount_text
    FROM main.SalaryDataset
),
profile AS (
    SELECT
        Location,
        Salary,
        suffix,
        REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(amount_text), '₹', ''), ',', '') AS amount
    FROM salary_formats
)
SELECT
    suffix,
    COUNT(*) AS records,
    COUNT(DISTINCT Location) AS locations,
    MIN(Salary) AS example_salary,
    SUM(CASE WHEN amount IS NULL OR amount = '' OR amount GLOB '*[^0-9]*'
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unusual_amounts,
    MIN(CASE WHEN amount IS NULL OR amount = '' OR amount GLOB '*[^0-9]*'
             THEN Salary END) AS unusual_example
FROM profile
GROUP BY suffix
ORDER BY records DESC

WITH RECURSIVE salary_characters(Salary, position) AS (
    SELECT Salary, 1
    FROM main.SalaryDataset
    WHERE length(Salary) > 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT Salary, position + 1
    FROM salary_characters
    WHERE position < length(Salary)
),
character_values AS (
    SELECT substr(Salary, position, 1) AS character, Salary
    FROM salary_characters
)
SELECT quote(character) AS character, COUNT(*) AS occurrences, MIN(Salary) AS example
FROM character_values
WHERE character NOT GLOB '[0-9]'
GROUP BY character
ORDER BY occurrences DESC

WITH RECURSIVE salary_digits(Location, CompanyName, remaining_text, digits) AS (
    SELECT Location, CompanyName, Salary, ''
    FROM main.SalaryDataset
    WHERE Salary IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        Location,
        CompanyName,
        substr(remaining_text, 2),
        digits || CASE
            WHEN substr(remaining_text, 1, 1) GLOB '[0-9]'
                THEN substr(remaining_text, 1, 1)
            ELSE ''
        END
    FROM salary_digits
    WHERE remaining_text <> ''
),
cleaned_salaries AS (
    -- Average the stored amounts after stripping currency and pay-period text.
    SELECT Location, CompanyName, CAST(digits AS REAL) AS salary_amount
    FROM salary_digits
    WHERE remaining_text = '' AND digits <> ''
),
city_company_averages AS (
    SELECT Location, CompanyName, AVG(salary_amount) AS city_average
    FROM cleaned_salaries
    WHERE Location IN ('Mumbai', 'Pune', 'New Delhi', 'Hyderabad')
    GROUP BY Location, CompanyName
),
ranked_companies AS (
    SELECT
        Location,
        CompanyName,
        city_average,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY Location
            ORDER BY city_average DESC, CompanyName
        ) AS city_rank
    FROM city_company_averages
),
national_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(salary_amount) AS country_average
    FROM cleaned_salaries
)
SELECT
    ranked_companies.Location AS "Location",
    ranked_companies.CompanyName AS "Company Name",
    ranked_companies.city_average AS "Average Salary in State",
    national_average.country_average AS "Average Salary in Country"
FROM ranked_companies
CROSS JOIN national_average
WHERE ranked_companies.city_rank <= 5
ORDER BY ranked_companies.Location, ranked_companies.city_rank
LIMIT 20
